scope: operational provenance, terms, attribution, and removal review for the six bounded math sources; not legal advice or a final ownership determination

finemath_4plus.human_decision_required: accept ODC attribution, Common Crawl terms, and residual underlying-page rights risk

infiwebmath_4plus.upstream: filtered English text-only InfiMM-WebMath material ultimately derived from web crawl data

megamath_web_pro.human_decision_required: accept ODC attribution, Common Crawl terms, and residual underlying-page rights risk

proof_pile_2_algebraic_stack.bounded_filter: 2,715 final Agda records from 363 repositories carry only allowlisted detected-license metadata: MIT 2,080 links, BSD-3-Clause 425, Apache-2.0 89, BSD-2-Clause 76, Unlicense 36, 0BSD 20, and MIT-0 1; counts are license links and can exceed record count
proof_pile_2_algebraic_stack.human_decision_required: approve the exact original-license allowlist, attribution/notice implementation, metadata reliability, and intended model/release scope, or reject this source

megamath_code.upstream: The Stack v2 metadata and Software Heritage blobs; each original file license and attribution remains applicable
megamath_code.bounded_filter: the adapter rejected 759,621 no-license/non-permissive metadata rows and 5,850 unsupported/missing detected-license rows; 1,729 final files from 1,331 repositories carry only the conservative allowlist
megamath_code.human_decision_required: approve the exact original-license allowlist, attribution/notice implementation, metadata reliability, and intended model/release scope, or reject this source

shared_material_observations: ODC-By grants database rights with attribution but expressly does not govern each item of content
Common Crawl use is a binding acceptance event and its indemnification clause expressly names AI training and deployment
Software Heritage blob availability and hash identity provide transport/provenance, not permission
source-level quality, language, PII, security, deduplication, and contamination gates do not resolve copyright or contractual rights
proposed_attribution_and_removal_control: retain source dataset/revision/shard, released-content hash, original URL or repository/path, blob identity, and detected licenses in immutable attribution manifests
publish ODC-By credits plus FineMath, InfiMM-WebMath, MegaMath, OpenWebMath, Proof-Pile-2, The Stack v2, Software Heritage, and Common Crawl citations as applicable
generate repository/file notice bundles for every included code record and preserve original license identifiers
name a human-controlled rights/privacy/removal contact before production acquisition
maintain URL/domain/blob/hash deny ledgers and rebuild affected packed shards rather than editing frozen evidence in place
decide source-data and packed-shard redistribution separately from model-weight release

acceptance_record_required.authority: named human with authority for the operating organization and intended use
must_record: accepted or rejected source IDs and exact evidence hashes
organization and intended research, publication, model-weight release, and any commercial scope
Common Crawl acceptance and terms date for web-derived sources
ODC-By attribution placement and underlying-page risk decision
approved original-code license allowlist and notice/attribution delivery
removal contact, deny-ledger owner, response procedure, and rebuild policy
date, name, and signature or equivalent auditable approval
